titleEn: Turn the ordering bot on or off

en: How do I turn the ordering bot off?

steps: Open Bot in Settings, then Switches
Turn Ordering bot on or off (applies at once; a note says what customers will see)
edgeCases: Ebda Store bridge down/unbound: store-linked features fall back (agent answers text only; orders cannot be created; COD outcomes cannot be recorded) and alert fires
